The '''Star Slinger''' was a prototype [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] that was developed on [[Shesharile 5]] by [[Chop Harlison]].

==Characteristic==
The Star Slinger combined the chassis of a [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] [[Nebulon-Q Swoop Racer|Nebulon-Q]] racer with the repulsor coils of an [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] [[64-Y Swift 3 Repulsorlift Sled|64-Y Swift 3]], and used a combination of [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas and stabilizers in elevated concentrations to provide added speed and cooling. It was also armed with a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] that was controlled with the targeting systems of a [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[PLX-2]] [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]].
